mn89:7.1: Practising mindfulness and meditation while walking.
mn89:8.4: This Sutta is one small incident in a long chain of events related in the *Dhammapada Comy.* (*Buddhist Legends, Vol. II, p. 43*). At this point Digha Kārāyana, who had a grudge against King Pasanadi for killing his kinsfolk on a false charge, took the emblems of royalty and rode back to the capital and had Viḍuḍabha the king's son crowned, while he left only a horse and a serving woman to the aged king. The latter sought help from his nephew King Ajātasattu of Magadha but reached his capital after the gates had closed. That night he died from exposure while sleeping in an open rest-house.
